ideas.pitch: An AI-powered group coordination and crowd-sourcing app for local Green Bay game day tailgates, optimizing parking spots, menu items, and carpooling for Lambeau Field visitors.
ideas.title: PackersTailgateAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem the local judges and Green Bay residents feel personally during every home game weekend.

ideas.pitch: An automated anomaly detection and risk scoring dashboard for local Green Bay manufacturing and logistics suppliers, combining geospatial data and predictive backtests.
ideas.title: TitletownSupplyChainMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven enterprise risk modeling and geospatial monitoring tailored to the industrial context of the region.

ideas.pitch: A real-time predictive forecasting tool tracking water quality and environmental hazards along the Fox River using Poisson regression models and public sensor datasets.
ideas.title: FoxRiverWaterSafety
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a clear, quantifiable environmental and social benefit directly tied to local geography.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutritional and menu discovery platform tailored for local Green Bay farm-to-table restaurants and dietary-restricted visitors.
ideas.title: LocalBitesGreenBay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven consumer-facing AI nutritional matching mechanisms with a local business twist.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized local marketplace for Wisconsin artisans using automated escrow contracts to secure peer-to-peer seasonal goods transactions.
ideas.title: DoorCountyMarketplaceEscrow
